verdict.rationale: Homebrew's Brewfile/bundle mechanism only supports `brew bundle check` (report whether the current install differs) and `brew bundle install` (reconcile) — there is no documented strict/immutable mode that fails a CI install when manifest and lockfile disagree, and Brewfile itself is not a version-locking lockfile. Community commentary even contrasts Homebrew's lack of reproducibility with tools like Nix, reinforcing the absence of this capability.
